Scene 1 – Approach to the Facility

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: Bolt stands before the rusted metal doors of an abandoned futuristic facility. Dark storm clouds swirl overhead, occasional lightning flashes illuminate the scene, and light rain begins to fall. The doors are massive, corroded, with warning symbols faded. Bolt’s sleek black exo‑suit with blue trim is visible; his visor is down, HUD glowing faintly, showing a pulsing icon for the Energy Core inside. Plasma cutter holstered on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt fully loaded.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same sleek exo‑suit, visor down, plasma cutter on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt with all gear intact.
Environment & Props: Exterior facility entrance, rusted doors, broken concrete slab, stormy sky, distant lightning, rain particles.
Character Actions: Bolt takes a confident step forward, visor HUD scanning the doors, then places a hand on the door panel as if preparing to breach.
Camera Direction & Movement: Slow dolly forward from a low angle tracking Bolt’s feet, rising to a medium shot that captures his upper body and the storm‑filled sky behind him.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Dim ambient light from stormy clouds, cool bluish tones, intermittent bright white lightning flashes creating dramatic highlights, rain adding a subtle gloss to surfaces.
Continuity: Opening scene; establishes Bolt at the facility entrance with all gear ready and the Energy Core still sealed inside the vault.
Dialogue (Hindi): "तूफान आ रहा है, जल्दी करना होगा".

Scene 2 – Grappling Hook Swing

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: Inside a dimly lit corridor lined with flickering emergency red lights, debris litters the floor, and a section of the floor has collapsed, leaving a gap. Bolt aims his grappling hook from his left thigh, fires a glowing tether that latches onto a reinforced ceiling beam, then swings across the gap.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same sleek black exo‑suit with blue trim, visor down, plasma cutter holstered on right thigh, grappling hook in motion from left thigh, utility belt with all gear intact.
Environment & Props: Corridor with emergency lighting, sparking wires, collapsed concrete, rusted pipes, the glowing grappling tether visible.
Character Actions: Bolt presses the grappling hook trigger, the tether extends and secures, he launches himself, tucks his legs, swings, lands firmly on the far side, and retracts the hook back to his thigh.
Camera Direction & Movement: Side‑view tracking the tether launch, then a dynamic follow‑through camera that arcs with Bolt’s swing, ending with a steady shot as he lands and the hook retracts.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Flickering emergency red lights casting moving shadows, occasional sparks from exposed wires, overall low‑key lighting with a tense, urgent feel.
Continuity: Bolt has entered the facility (door now open behind him) and is progressing deeper; the Energy Core remains untouched in the vault, all gear as outlined.
Dialogue (Hindi): "पकड़ लिया"

Scene 3 – Plasma Cutter Breach

Duration: 6 seconds
Visual Prompt: Bolt arrives at a massive vault chamber dominated by a biometric scanner and a pedestal. The vault door is a thick reinforced alloy panel. He activates the plasma cutter from his right thigh, a bright blue‑white arc ignites as he cuts a circular opening in the panel, sparks flying. The cut section loosens and falls away, revealing the glowing Energy Core resting on the pedestal.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same exo‑suit, visor down (HUD locked on the core), plasma cutter active in hand, grappling hook secured on thigh, utility belt.
Environment & Props: Vault interior, massive door with biometric scanner, pedestal with a faint blue glow from the Core, scattered tool marks, ambient dust.
Character Actions: Bolt steadies the cutter, traces a circle, the panel releases, he steps back as the section drops, then raises his visor slightly to view the exposed Core.
Camera Direction & Movement: Close‑up on the plasma arc cutting metal, then a swift pull‑back to a medium shot showing the whole vault door opening and the Core on pedestal, finishing with a slow push‑in on the Core’s glow.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Intense bright blue‑white plasma light casting sharp highlights and deep shadows, ambient vault lighting dim, creating a high‑contrast, dramatic scene.
Continuity: Bolt is now at the vault door having used the grappling hook to reach this point; the Energy Core is visible and untouched, transport case empty on belt, EMP grenade loaded, etc.
Dialogue (Hindi): "कट सफल"

Scene 4 – Securing the Core

Duration: 4 seconds
Visual Prompt: Bolt approaches the pedestal, extends magnetic clamps from his utility belt, and lifts the Energy Core. The clamps emit a soft blue field, securing the Core as it is lowered into the open transport case attached to his belt. The case snaps shut with a soft click, the Core now fully enclosed.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Unchanged exo‑suit, visor down (HUD indicating “Core Secured”), plasma cutter holstered, grappling hook on thigh, utility belt now with the transport case attached and sealed.
Environment & Props: Vault chamber beside the pedestal, transport case open then closing, magnetic clamp fixtures visible, faint glow from the Core leaking through the case seams.
Character Actions: Bolt positions the clamps, lifts the Core smoothly, guides it into the case, releases clamps, and confirms the case latch engages.
Camera Direction & Movement: Over‑the‑shoulder shot following Bolt’s hands, then a tight push‑in on the case latch clicking shut, finishing with a medium shot of Bolt holding the sealed case at his side.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Same plasma‑lit ambience from previous scene, now supplemented by a soft internal blue glow from the sealed case, creating a contained, focused illumination.
Continuity: The Energy Core is now sealed inside the transport case, which is attached to Bolt’s utility belt; all other gear statuses match the outline (jetpack stowed, EMP grenade loaded, etc.).
Dialogue (Hindi): "कोर सुरक्षित"

Scene 5 – EMP Drone Disable

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: In the corridor just outside the vault chamber, a dormant security drone with red optical sensors powers up, its rotors whirring. Bolt reacts, draws the EMP grenade from his utility belt, pulls the pin, and hurls it toward the drone. The grenade detonates in a bright white EMP pulse; the drone’s lights flicker and it collapses to the floor, sparking.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same sleek exo‑suit, visor down (HUD showing “Drone Disabled”), plasma cutter holstered, grappling hook retracted on thigh, utility belt with the EMP slot now empty, transport case still sealed and attached.
Environment & Props: Corridor with emergency lighting, the security drone (metallic frame, red eyes, antennae), the thrown EMP grenade mid‑arc, EMP burst visible as a ripple.
Character Actions: Bolt spots the drone, reaches for the EMP grenade, throws it with an overhand motion, watches the explosion, then continues walking forward past the disabled drone.
Camera Direction & Movement: Starts on the drone powering up, tracks the grenade’s arc, captures the EMP flash in slow‑motion, then follows Bolt’s forward movement as the drone falls.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Emergency red lights casting stark shadows, the EMP burst adds an intense white‑blue flash that momentarily overpowers the scene, then returns to dim red ambience.
Continuity: EMP grenade used (expended, slot empty), Energy Core remains sealed in case on belt, all other equipment as per outline, Bolt moving toward the exit.
Dialogue (Hindi): "निष्क्रिय"

Scene 6 – Flooded Corridor Escape

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: Bolt sprints down a main corridor now flooded with ankle‑deep water, debris crashing from the ceiling as the storm outside intensifies; lightning flashes illuminate the scene, casting stark shadows; Bolt lowers his visor, HUD highlighting a safe exit route in green; he slides under a falling metal beam, water splashing around his boots; the transport case stays sealed on his utility belt, plasma cutter and grappling hook remain holstered.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same sleek black exo‑suit with blue trim, visor down, HUD showing exit route, plasma cutter on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt with all gear except empty EMP slot, transport case firmly attached to belt.
Environment & Props: Main corridor, water inundation, floating debris, emergency lights flickering, storm‑lit windows showing torrential rain, ceiling panels buckling, scattered sparks.
Character Actions: Bolt runs forward, thrusts his arms for balance, slides under a falling debris piece, then rises and continues toward the exit, keeping his head low to avoid falling shards; he glances at his HUD for navigation.
Camera Direction & Movement: Starts with a tracking shot from behind Bolt’s feet, moving forward as he runs; tilts up to show water and debris; switches to a side‑profile slow‑motion as he slides under the beam, then returns to a forward tracking shot as he approaches the corridor exit.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Dim emergency red‑orange lighting mixed with bright white lightning flashes; water reflects light, creating glimmering surfaces; atmosphere tense, with distant thunder rumbling and rain pounding outside visible through broken walls.
Continuity: Picks up from Scene 5 where Bolt moved toward the exit with the Energy Core sealed in the case on his belt, EMP expended; all gear matches the end state of Scene 5 (case on belt, visor down, HUD showing drone disabled now updated to exit route).
Dialogue (Hindi): "जल्दी बाहर निकलना होगा"

Scene 7 – Plateau Jetpack Launch

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: Bolt bursts onto the open plateau outside the facility; torrential rain and lightning strike the landscape; he activates his jetpack, blue thrust flaring from the packs on his back, lifting him off the ground as he angles away from the collapsing facility; the transport case remains sealed on his belt, plasma cutter and grappling hook holstered, visor down showing a safe‑zone vector on HUD.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same exo‑suit, visor down, jetpack ignited (thrust visible), plasma cutter on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt with case attached, EMP slot empty.
Environment & Props: Expanse of rocky plateau, storm‑dark sky, heavy rain, lightning bolts, the facility silhouette in background with smoke and debris, wind‑driven rain.
Character Actions: Bolt jumps forward, triggers jetpack throttle, leans forward to gain speed, looks over his shoulder at the facility as it shakes, then arcs upward and away.
Camera Direction & Movement: Begins with a low angle wide shot of the plateau, captures Bolt’s emergence; quickly tilts up to follow his ascent with a rising crane shot; ends with a medium shot of Bolt jet‑packing away, facility receding.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Storm‑lit environment with frequent bright white lightning flashes illuminating rain‑streaked scene; jetpack thrust adds a vivid blue‑white glow; overall cool, high‑contrast lighting.
Continuity: Continues from Scene 6 where Bolt was near the facility exit, case on belt, jetpack stowed; now he activates jetpack as storm peaks.
Dialogue (Hindi): "जेटपैक चालू!"

Scene 8 – Bunker Airlock Seal

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: Bolt reaches the reinforced bunker entrance, a massive steel airlock door; he slams the door shut, engages the hydraulic seals, then lifts the transport case from his belt and places it onto an internal storage rack inside the airlock; his visor retracts upward for a clear interior view; the jetpack remains attached but throttled down, fuel low.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same exo‑suit, visor up (retracted), plasma cutter on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt now without the case (empty slot where case was), jetpack still attached, fuel low indicator on HUD.
Environment & Props: Bunker airlock doorway interior, heavy steel door with sealing mechanisms, interior storage rack with magnetic mounts, dim interior lighting, faint red emergency strips.
Character Actions: Bolt pushes the door closed, turns a sealing wheel, hears the hiss of pressure equalization, then lifts the case with both hands and sets it onto the rack, steps back.
Camera Direction & Movement: Starts with a medium shot of Bolt approaching the door, then a close‑up on the door sealing mechanism, followed by an over‑the‑shoulder view as he places the case on the rack, ending with a wide shot showing the sealed airlock and Bolt standing by the rack.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Interior lighting is subdued amber with emergency strips casting a soft glow; outside the bunker, storm rages visible through reinforced glass, lightning flashes occasionally.
Continuity: Follows Scene 7 where Bolt jet‑packed away, case on belt, jetpack active fuel consuming; now he arrives at bunker, seals door, removes case, jetpack throttled down.
Dialogue (Hindi): "दरवाज़ा बंद"

Scene 9 – Core Transfer to Containment Chamber

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: Inside the bunker, Bolt walks to the containment chamber adjacent to the storage rack; he opens the transport case, lifts the glowing Energy Core, and plugs its power conduits into the chamber’s receptacles; the core settles into a cradle, emitting a steady blue glow; Bolt steps back, visor up showing HUD readout of core stability; plasma cutter and grappling hook remain holstered, utility belt equipped, jetpack attached low fuel.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same exo‑suit, visor up, HUD displaying core stability readings, plasma cutter on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt with jetpack attached, EMP slot empty, transport case now open and empty on rack.
Environment & Props: Containment chamber: cylindrical vessel with transparent shielding, power conduit ports, magnetic cradle, soft blue illumination; storage rack nearby with open case; ambient bunker lighting.
Character Actions: Bolt opens case with a latch, lifts core using magnetic grips on his gloves, aligns core with conduits, inserts plugs, watches the core activate and glow, then steps back.
Camera Direction & Movement: Begins with an over‑the‑shoulder view of Bolt at the rack, tracks his movement to the chamber, close‑up on the core being inserted, then pulls back to a wide shot showing both rack and chamber with Bolt standing beside.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Cool blue glow from the core contrasts with warm amber bunker lights; subtle haze from energy emission; overall calm after storm.
Continuity: From Scene 8 where case placed on rack, jetpack throttled down, visor up; now he transfers core to chamber, case empties, core active.
Dialogue (Hindi): "स्थिर"

Scene 10 – Mission Complete

Duration: 5 seconds
Visual Prompt: The storm has cleared; sunlight breaks over the ruined facility, casting golden light across the plateau; Bolt stands outside the bunker doorway, tablet in his left hand displaying the Energy Core’s stable read‑out; he gives a thumbs‑up, visor up, exo‑suit glistening with residual rain; the jetpack is attached but fuel depleted, transport case empty on rack inside bunker visible through the open doorway.
Character Appearance & Clothing: Same sleek black exo‑suit with blue trim, visor up (retracted), plasma cutter on right thigh, grappling hook on left thigh, utility belt equipped (jetpack low fuel, EMP empty), tablet in left hand, thumb raised.
Environment & Props: Bunker doorway exterior, clear sky with sun rays, distant facility silhouette under clearing storm, debris scattered, sunlight reflecting off wet surfaces; tablet showing holographic read‑out of core status.
Character Actions: Bolt steps out, holds tablet at chest level, glances at the read‑out, then raises his right hand in a thumbs‑up gesture, looks toward the facility.
Camera Direction & Movement: Starts with a wide establishing shot of the bunker entrance under sunlight, dolly in to a medium shot of Bolt with tablet, then a close‑up on the tablet screen and his thumbs‑up, finishes with a slight pull‑out to show both Bolt and the cleared sky.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Warm golden sunlight, soft shadows, lens flares from sun; atmosphere hopeful, tranquil after storm.
Continuity: From Scene 9 where core stabilized in chamber, case empty on rack, jetpack low fuel, visor up; now Bolt exits bunker, checks tablet, signals completion.
Dialogue (Hindi): "मिशन पूरा"
